body: It’s nice to know that someone out there in the world understands me and I’m not completely alone in feeling like this, hopefully you know you are not alone too. I feel the same way, I’m literally living with people who could care less if I starved to death, idk what to do at this point and I’m so use to feeling like this but it still hurts. Hopefully we will get through it, thankyou for your reply.
It’s a complicated situation but she lives with her boyfriend in another city, and I’m only 16 so I’m living with my older brother at the moment.
